headline: Solid-for-here S swell to 3ft, but cross-on wind keeps it textured.
today: Best size of the region at 2-3ft on a good angle, though the SSW is cross-on from dawn onward at 9-12mph so it stays bumpy. Work the morning around the incoming to the afternoon high before the wind adds up. Shortboard or fish — there's enough push to have fun if you're not fussy about texture.

daysToWatch.note: Lightest morning wind of the run (6mph) with the swell still 2-2.8ft — cleaner dawn window before it builds.
Biggest swell of the stretch, 2.2-3.1ft. Cross wind manageable in the morning but ramps to 20mph by evening, so go early.
NNW offshore at dawn with 2.2-2.7ft holding — cleanest day on the board. Get it before the wind swings around midday.
